//TR: Bu checkpoint gözetimsiz orkestratör yürütücülerinin gerçek git depolarıyla entegrasyon testlerini kaydeder; yalnız test ve belge ekler, hiçbir protected dosyaya dokunmaz ve bekleyen review paketlerinin kapsamını değiştirmez.

founderAuthorization.rule: Founder rule 2026-09-29: A blocked/review-pending package blocks ONLY its own dependency lane. While a package waits for Codex/review/provider availability, preserve its exact frozen review scope, do not modify its branch, frozen bundle, review clone, evidence or review-cycle state, do not merge it before the required CLEAN review, and immediately implement the next independent eligible package in an isolated branch, validate, checkpoint, commit, prepare the frozen review bundle, mark it REVIEW_PENDING if Codex is unavailable, and continue.
founderAuthorization.constraint: Tests and non-protected documentation only; no protected file, no pending package scope, no merge.

rationale: PKG-AUT1 scenario tests used fake executors; this package runs the real executors against real temporary git repositories before the orchestrator is activated, so defects in merge, adoption, signing, Phase0 or builder-round scope checks surface without touching the construction repository.
scenarios: merge fast-forward with CLEAN evidence, idempotent, auditable in the reflog
merge refuses non-fast-forward, missing, mismatched and BLOCKED evidence
review adopts a completed run without any provider or script process and records the unmodified result
signing waits when the agent key is missing or the agent is down, signs with the public key only, adopts valid signatures and binds allowed_signers to identity and namespace
Phase0 rejects a tampered ZIP, binds install.ps1 to the approved remote, adopts a finished install and refuses to move a previous install outside the C:/UASCO failed-attempt pattern
packaging adopts a complete release and preserves an incomplete one before rebuilding
builder round rejects out-of-scope, unauthorized protected and trust-manifest edits and empty output without moving the branch or running validation
real git contracts stay confined to policy roots
findingsInAut1: none; every scenario passed against the unchanged PKG-AUT1 executors

validation.workspace: fresh clone of 9e5549f (PKG-T2 re-applied on PKG-AUT1 cycle 3 c48d54d) mirroring the cycle-2 working tree, reviewed lock installed
validation.executorIntegrationSelftest: PASS 9/9 (adds real-git-is-isolated-from-host-hooks-and-signing; reverting the isolation fails it)
validation.rerunAfterCheckpointFinalized: canonical runner rerun on the final tree before commit

aut1Cycle2Compatibility.reason: PKG-AUT1 cycle 2 (0faf2aa) made the executors stricter; five scenarios encoded the older behaviour and now assert the stricter one instead (no assertion removed without a stronger replacement).
changes: merge scenarios use real review evidence (reviewer text, manifest output hash, frozen bundle) because the merge gate re-derives the decision
review adoption re-evaluates the unchanged reviewer output in a real review clone; a cached BLOCKED governed-result is overwritten by the re-derived CLEAN and the provider is not called
Phase0 uses a signed acceptance report bound to a git-backed installation (installId, source commit, trust root, inputs) and the signed release trust-root digest

packaging adoption keeps the verified sources in the release directory; a tampered handoff copy is repaired from them (kept as .invalid), and a corrupt source forces a rebuild with the previous release and handoff preserved as -incomplete
the fixture repository carries the review schemas and settings a real review clone needs

aut1Cycle3Compatibility.change: the merge scenarios bind the package's frozen bundle digest to the evidence bundle (AUT1 cycle 3 rejects CLEAN evidence for another bundle before any git operation); a new assertion proves that CLEAN evidence for another bundle on the same commit is rejected.

F-T2-001.observed: the adoption scenario asserted only that the reviewer broker was not called while dependency and provenance scripts were recorded.
F-T2-001.fix: with PKG-AUT1 cycle 3 the executor adopts a completed run in a git-only review tree, so the scenario now asserts zero recorded script or provider calls, exactly the frozen criterion, against the unchanged executors.

F-T2-002.observed: fixture Git commands and the executor Git pass-through inherited host configuration, so host hooks or commit signing could run outside the recorder.
F-T2-002.fix: every real Git process of the fixture (gitIn and the runner pass-through) runs with automation/lib/git-isolation.mjs (no host global/system/injected config, templates, hooks or automatic signing).
F-T2-002.retest: real-git-is-isolated-from-host-hooks-and-signing: a host config with a sentinel hooks path and mandatory signing through a missing signer breaks unisolated Git (negative control) but reaches no process through the fixture or the executors (merge and adoption pass, no hook marker); reverting the isolation makes this scenario fail.
